low.title: Phase-2 receipt evidence values are placeholder strings, not real receipts/hashes
low.description: The candidate receipt's evidence block contains literal placeholder strings ('required-per-game-proof', 'required-selected-output-proof', 'required-advantage-games-proof', 'required-reading-proof', 'required-primary-proof', 'required-exact-retirement-path', 'required-exact-retirement-hash'). The validator only checks structural presence (truthy dict/non-empty string) and any non-empty value passes. This means the candidate is shape-valid for testing the gate but carries no actual receipt content. This is consistent with the planning-only/non-consumable posture and the explicit crosswalk-block, but a future reviewer should be aware that adding real-looking receipts without changing shape would still pass.
low.severity_rationale: Does not break any validator check; the candidate is intentionally placeholder-marked and remains crosswalk-blocked. Recorded so the planning-only vs. contents-only distinction remains visible.

low.title: Phase-2 validator does not run the Phase-1 forbidden-claim-key scan over the receipt
low.description: validate_phase2_readiness.py enforces schema shape, archive hashes, in-archive restrictions, disclosure set/status, evidence shape, and the crosswalk-block, but it does not run the FORBIDDEN_CLAIM_KEYS scan that validate_phase1_crosswalk.py enforces over the crosswalk. The top-level 'ready: false'/'consumable: false' flags are explicit, but if a future contributor injects a nested adoption_success/browser_success/performance_success/host_success/gameplay_success/gameplay_claim field into the receipt, the Phase-2 validator would not catch it. Phase-2 currently relies on authoring discipline plus Phase-1's separate validator.
low.severity_rationale: Receipts are planning-only and authored under the same review envelope; defense-in-depth here is a Phase-2 hardening, not a defect of the current candidate.

low.title: Receipt crosswalk_product_owner_acceptance is not auto-verified against the crosswalk artifact
low.description: The Phase-2 validator trusts the receipt's crosswalk_product_owner_acceptance field without re-loading the Phase-1 crosswalk JSON and confirming its governance.product_owner_acceptance matches. If the receipt's flag were flipped to 'accepted' independently, the gate would still surface PUBLICATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (consistent fail-closed), but that flag is not cross-checked against the crosswalk artifact itself.
low.severity_rationale: Trust separation is defensible (Phase-1 owns crosswalk truth; Phase-2 owns receipt truth), and any flip still fails closed at PUBLICATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, but cross-checking the two sources would be cleaner defense-in-depth.

low.title: Receipt claims an absent Phase-1 crosswalk owner acceptance
low.description: The candidate receipt's crosswalk_product_owner_acceptance field is 'absent'. The Phase-1 independent review already classified the crosswalk disposition as research-evidence pass with one LOW informational note and explicitly recorded product_owner_acceptance as not-requested and downstream_authorization as blocked. The Phase-2 candidate is consistent with that state and correctly fails closed at CROSSWALK_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE_ABSENT.
low.severity_rationale: Correct, consistent, and intentionally absent. Recorded for traceability only.

No critical, high, or medium findings require remediation. Per spec and the candidate's own claim boundary, product-owner acceptance, cohort readiness, gameplay claims, and downstream authorization remain absent and are explicitly NOT asserted by this report.
